description: Discover our charming 125 m² townhouse, fully renovated and bathed in light. Located at the end of a quiet and secure private cul-de-sac, it offers an ideal living environment with no overlooking neighbours for your summer stays. You will enjoy the atmosphere of a popular and lively neighbourhood, while remaining in absolute calm.Ideal location: A 15-minute walk from the Stade de France and the Olympic Aquatic Centre, and a stone's throw from shops. Four-legged companions are welcome!The space0️⃣ Ground floor: Entrance with shoe cabinet, storage tray and coat rack. Large open-plan living room (living room, kitchen, dining room). In the living room: two sofas, a bookcase with board games and a television (140 cm). In the kitchen, there are two large countertops with a central dining table for 6 people (extendable for 10 people). Adjacent wooded terrace with a dining table and an electric plancha. 1️⃣1st floor: 1 bathroom with double vanities and bathtub3 Bedrooms with Double bed 1 WC 2️⃣2nd floor: master suite with dressing room, bathroom (shower and toilet) and private south-facing terrace. 🏵️​🌻​🏵️125 m² house over three floorsSleeps 8: 4 queen-size double beds (can be increased to 10 beds for an additional charge)High-speed wifiFully equipped kitchen: hob, microwave, latest-generation electric oven, fridge, dishwasher, appliances (coffee machine, food processor, sparkling water machine, kettle and toaster) Bathroom with bathtub and double washbasins (towel dryer, hairdryer) shower room with shower and WC Close to the Stade de France and transport to ParisThe basement is furnished, but we leave our belongings there during rentals.
